scenes.title: THE SPACE SURVIVED
scenes.narration: You cleaned a name with Excel TRIM, but the hidden space remained. It might be a nonbreaking space.

scenes.title: THE REAL CAUSE
scenes.narration: Microsoft explains that TRIM handles normal ASCII spaces, but does not remove character one sixty by itself.

scenes.title: THE TEST
scenes.narration: In this invented row, check the character code instead of repeatedly running the same formula.

scenes.title: THE FIX
scenes.narration: Replace character one sixty with an ordinary space using SUBSTITUTE, then wrap the result in TRIM.
